categories_thin: Independent hardware - none found; the Old Bridge hardware market is Home Depot, Lowe's and Harbor Freight (all excluded chains).

Bicycle shops, musical instrument dealers, toy shops, party-supply stores, trophy/engraving shops - no Old Bridge Township independent storefront surfaced; searches returned Matawan, Sayreville, Monroe, Edison and Perth Amboy businesses.
Independent hotels/motels - only the branded Hampton Inn is verifiable in town; two old motel listings could not be confirmed as operating.
Picture framing, screen printing/embroidery - only home-based or out-of-town operators appeared; home-based addresses were deliberately excluded.
Independent retail generally is thin because Route 9 retail in Old Bridge is overwhelmingly chain-anchored (Target, Kohl's, Marshalls, Five Below, Petco, Mattress Warehouse, etc.).
caveats: Parlin (08859) straddles Old Bridge Township and Sayreville Township. Bordentown Avenue and Ernston Road addresses are generally the Old Bridge side; Washington Road addresses are generally Sayreville and are flagged where included.
Laurence Harbor (08879) is at roughly the 10-mile boundary from central Milltown; its businesses are marked for radius re-check.
Route 18 and Route 34 addresses (GMI Designs, Artworks360, PMTutoring, BridgeLife Thrift, Old Bridge School of Dance, Matawan Montessori) sit near municipal lines and should be geo-checked.

National chains and franchise locations identified and deliberately excluded include Target, Kohl's, Marshalls, Five Below, Dollar Tree, Petco, Sally Beauty, Mattress Warehouse, Sleep Number, Ashley-type chains, Hampton Inn, KinderCare, Goddard School, Primrose, Lightbridge Academy, The Learning Experience, Montessori Kids Universe, Kumon, H&R Block, The UPS Store, FedEx Office and Woof Gang Bakery.
Home-based businesses (photographers and embroiderers found at residential street addresses) were excluded to respect the no-home-address rule; this modestly reduces completeness.
Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, Chamber of Commerce, D&B and OpenStreetMap/Overpass endpoints blocked automated access, so several bulk directories could only be used through search-result snippets.
data_gaps: No complete industrial tenant census. The Central 9 Logistics Park buildings on Jake Brown Road / Fairway Lane (tenants reported: Paragon Packaging, Linktrans, JD Logistics, KCL Fulfillment) and the Jocama Boulevard / Nicholas Drive / Perrine Road business parks are only partly captured; most tenants there are large nationals or could not be tied to a verified suite address.
Child care coverage relies on the state licensed-centre list; licensed family child care homes and license-exempt religious programs are not in it and were not enumerated.

Several directory-only entries need confirmation via a call or map check: In Style Furniture, Best Home Furnishings, Magic Years Nursery School, Collectors Coins & Jewelry, Bright Signs, Artworks360, Poker Industries, Forman Industries, Circle Motor Lodge, Desi Inn.
No reliable source listed Old Bridge manufacturers by SIC; the manufacturer list is therefore opportunistic and almost certainly incomplete.
Trophy/awards, framing and bicycle retail were confirmed absent in-town from the sources available, but a phone-book print directory could reveal one or two more.
